periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oriented diagonally downward towards the nasal region at approximately 30 to 45 degrees from the transverse facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Pronounced oval elongation with a horizontal-to-vertical ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering at the ventral-medial edge, indicating a shift from the geometric center towards the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively flat U-shape across the posterior margin with minimal indentation at the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad thickness, covering approximately 45% of the visible dorsal-thoracic segment.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation where the gap between the medial ear bases exceeds the maximum width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent semicircular curvature with smooth, rounded tops.

other_distinctive_markers: The white dorsal pelage displays a distinctive ruffled or 'spiky' texture particularly where it meets the anterior edge of the dark shoulder band.
